subject.title: Feature: allow account switching from /models buttons for GPT and Claude

question: Should `/models` grow a shared cross-channel account/auth-profile selector for provider-backed models, and what persistence semantics should it use with `/model ...@profile` and auth order?
rationale: The source path is clear, but adding picker-side account switching changes provider/auth UX, session state, and channel callback contracts, so automation should not choose the product behavior.

options.title: Define shared picker contract
options.body: Add account/profile metadata and actions to the shared `/models` surface, then implement channel renderers against that contract.

options.title: Keep typed account controls
options.body: Keep `/model ...@profile`, `/model status`, and CLI auth order as the supported account-switching path and close this feature as not planned.

options.title: Pilot one channel behind shared data
options.body: Start with one channel only if maintainers first define the shared model/profile data shape so the pilot does not become a divergent contract.

recommendation.title: Define shared picker contract
recommendation.body: Add account/profile metadata and actions to the shared `/models` surface, then implement channel renderers against that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent provider identity, runtime choice, and session override work crosses the same product boundary this decision needs.
